params._momAddress: Address of the mother Aminal (0x0 for genesis)

returns._0: energyGained The amount of energy gained from this feeding "To feed an Aminal is to nourish its digital soul,  creating bonds that transcend the boundaries of code"

params.aminalId: The Aminal ID to generate attributes for

returns._0: JSON string containing array of attribute objects

params.aminalID: The Aminal ID to get visuals for (must match this Aminal)

returns._0: visuals The visual traits of this Aminal
energy The current energy available for actions

params.user: Address to check love balance for

returns._0: love The amount of love the user has given to this Aminal

returns.dad: Address of the father Aminal (0x0 for genesis)
returns.mom: Address of the mother Aminal (0x0 for genesis)

returns._0: totalLove The cumulative love from all interactions
visuals The Visuals struct containing all trait IDs

payout(uint256,address).details: Only callable by GeneAuction contract during settlement

squeak(uint256).details: Consumes love and energy to create a squeak - a digital cry of expression
